# Pickable

> Pickable is a public website analysis demo. It combines agent-readiness observations from Ora and Cloudflare's isitagentready.com with basic marketing visibility checks. Scores describe available evidence; they do not guarantee task completion, referrals, rankings, or revenue.

## Product
- [Pickable home](https://solveny.dev/): enter a public domain to request an asynchronous scan.
- [About Pickable](https://solveny.dev/about): purpose, sources, and score limitations.
- [Demo and limits](https://solveny.dev/pricing): free public demo and configured resource limits.

## Important behavior
- Scan creation is asynchronous. Poll the scan status endpoint and treat a report received while sources are running as partial.
- Scan history, statuses, reports, previews, and intelligence reads are scoped to the caller’s direct peer IP address. Forwarded-IP headers are not trusted; clients behind a reverse proxy may share the same scope. This is not account authentication or a confidentiality guarantee. Provider evidence is redacted and raw-source endpoints return 404.
- REST scan creation uses a CSRF token from GET /api/config or a configured operator-issued bearer key.
- MCP read tools are available by default. MCP scan creation requires both server-operator opt-in and bearer authorization.
- The MCP HTTP endpoint accepts POST requests; use the agent integration guide or server card for connection details.
- Follow Retry-After when scan submission returns 429.
